_about: Read-only tools over a Gmail intake service (MS) and its email agent. Copy to /etc/aegis/http-tools.json, point AEGIS_HTTP_TOOLS at it, and put GMAIL_MS_ADMIN_KEY and GMAIL_MS_AGENT_KEY in /opt/aegis/.env. Deliberately absent: GET /admin/diag/agent (it POSTs a synthetic email to the agent) and /admin/oauth/start.

tools.name: ms_mailboxes
tools.description: Every watched mailbox with its health, company and Gmail watch state. Use first for 'is the system healthy' and 'is the watch about to expire'.

tools.name: ms_mailbox
tools.description: One mailbox in detail: company, OAuth health, watch expiry, last history id.

tools.name: ms_pending_deliveries

query.mailbox: optional mailbox address to filter by

tools.description: Emails received but not yet delivered to the agent. Non-empty for long = delivery is stuck.

tools.name: ms_failed_deliveries

query.mailbox: optional mailbox address to filter by

tools.description: Emails whose delivery to the agent failed permanently after retries.

tools.name: ms_quarantined

query.mailbox: optional mailbox address to filter by

tools.description: Emails held back because no company could be matched to the sender. The answer to 'we never got their email'.

tools.name: ms_workers
tools.description: Background workers (watch renewal, delivery retry, sync): alive or not, last run, last error.

tools.name: ms_thread_conversation
tools.description: The whole thread as the system stored it: every inbound email and every reply we sent, with bodies. Read from the service's own database, no Gmail call. Use to see what the customer wrote and what we answered.

tools.name: agent_action_queue

query.status: PENDING (default), DONE, or empty for all

tools.description: Items the agent handed to a human: manual takeover, ambiguous field, employee identity, per-diem, work address. Each listing costs the CRM a call - do not repeat it in a loop.

tools.name: agent_action_item
tools.description: One handover item in full: why the agent gave up and what it needs from a human.
